scope: Trainability smoke for the leakage-free metric flower VACE data
summary: After retaining three environment failures, the pinned rank-4 VACE trainer completes all 12 steps and emits a reproducible adapter.
evidence: The first attempt failed before model load because Accelerate lacked the DiffSynth root in PYTHONPATH; the second exposed missing declared modelscope, and the third exposed missing declared librosa.
The corrected environment imports the complete pinned trainer, ModelScope 1.39.1, and librosa 0.11.0.
Physical A800 GPU 1 runs 12/12 steps in approximately 27 seconds.
Metadata binds the dataset manifest, model files, DiffSynth commit, GPU, source Git state, packages, seed, command, and PYTHONPATH prefix.
lessons: A successful checkpoint preparation is not a complete trainer environment; the actual entrypoint import must be preflighted.
limitations: Successful optimization alone does not establish held-out or real-video improvement.
next_actions: Compare zero-shot and adapted outputs on a source-frame-disjoint contact window with identical inputs and seed.
